title: King Oliver on Red Allen and his father
summary: Oliver thought Red Allen and his father both fine trumpeters, with the father vibrating by shaking his head.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Did he ever mention anything about other trumpet players
who were coming around at that time, in the early 30's? Any kind of feelings or opinions that he had about some other trumpet players?
Yeah, he used to talk about Red Allen.
What did he say about Red Allen?

He said Red's a good trumpet player. He said Red's old man was a good trumpet player. He'd come along with King -- Red's father. He said both of them played just alike. He said Red took after his Daddy. You know, Red vibrated by shaking his head. He didn't do that...
He didn't shake the fingers or the lip. He'd shake... King said he used to be comin' down, Red's father did -- [SINGS] He'd be shakin' his head.
